title: BXDL pinned runtime lock v1
description: Trusted maintainer input for offline runtime stage on the darwin/arm64 Java 21 profile. files pins the entire extracted Java Home after permitted internal file symlinks are materialized. Archive/sourceArchive fields preserve upstream provenance and are not authenticated or downloaded by runtime stage. Runtime validation additionally checks unique paths, exact full inventory, path restrictions, file/directory conflicts, a 4 GiB total, and bin/java SHA-256 equality with javaSha256. A matching lock does not certify JVM execution, engine compatibility, license completeness, or product release readiness.

vendor.description: Nonempty trimmed label without control characters; runtime validator also enforces a 256-byte UTF-8 limit.

version.description: Nonempty trimmed label without control characters; runtime validator also enforces a 256-byte UTF-8 limit.

files.description: Complete expected regular-file inventory using Java Home relative paths. All parent directories are implied. Duplicate path names and total size over 4294967296 bytes are rejected by the runtime validator.

path.description: Path relative to the complete extracted Java Home, such as bin/java. runtime/ is added by staging. Runtime validation rejects dot components, forbidden secret/data paths and suffixes, overlong UTF-8 paths and final components over 100 bytes.

mode.description: Normalized materialized regular-file mode: decimal 420 is 0644, decimal 493 is 0755.

archive.description: Pinned upstream provenance only. runtime stage does not download or verify this archive; the maintainer must independently verify supplied archive bytes against the trusted lock.

name.description: Trimmed archive filename without separators or control characters; runtime validator also enforces the UTF-8 byte limit.

url.description: HTTPS provenance reference, not a request to download; runtime validator also enforces the UTF-8 byte limit.
